data.one_liner: An Android Flutter plugin providing access to the Cronet HTTP client.
data.what_it_does: Provides an Android Flutter plugin that accesses the Cronet HTTP client, supporting features like HTTP/3, configurable caching, and Android HTTP proxies.
use_when: You need advanced Android HTTP features like HTTP/3 or configurable caching.
You want to use the package:http Client interface with Cronet on Android.
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms other than Android.
You prefer the default socket-based dart:io HttpClient.
strengths: Automatically supports Android platform features such as HTTP proxies.
Supports more HTTP features such as HTTP/3.
weaknesses: Depends on Google Play Services by default unless configured for embedded Cronet.
data.setup_notes: Can optionally use embedded Cronet without Google Play Services by setting the dart-define `cronetHttpNoPlay=true`.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: For a standard cross-platform HTTP client without Android-specific Cronet engine configuration.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: For a powerful HTTP client with interceptors, global configuration, and form data support.
